svg.aria-label: Notification system final design. Services send a notify request with an idempotency key to the notification service, which deduplicates, looks up user preferences and device tokens, applies quiet hours and per-user rate limits, renders the template, and writes one message per channel to a queue: push, email and SMS. Scheduled notifications wait in a scheduler first. Channel workers send to providers such as APNs, FCM, an email service or an SMS gateway, retrying with backoff; messages that keep failing go to a dead-letter queue. Every attempt is recorded in a delivery log, and provider callbacks report delivered, opened or bounced; invalid device tokens are removed.
